title: HOTFIX: presenceRender.test.ts red on main — undefined.paths
description: ROOT CAUSE: task 1378 (commit 11fe408) made getTransformedBounds/simpleBox in packages/core/src/engine/bounds.ts unconditionally delegate type shape/drawing-object to transformedShapeBounds, which reads obj.shape.paths. A lightweight presence selection target (RemoteCursorsOverlay, task 1345) carries x/y/width/height but no .shape, so shapeBounds(undefined) threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading paths)'. FIX: guard both delegation sites on the presence of obj.shape; a shape lacking geometry falls back to x/y/width/height.
